title: Review
description: A single hand-written review of a run: a per-domain quality rating, a markdown writeup, and the reviewer's checklist verdicts, attributed to the authenticated account that submitted it. A run may carry MANY reviews — one per account — so this is both the submission shape (POST /runs/{id}/reviews, where the reviewer identity is taken from the bearer token rather than the body) and the per-entry shape served back in the reviews array. A run's overall rating is the worst across every domain of every review; its score is the average of each review's earned-over-declared checklist weight. Publishing a run requires at least one review.

reviewerId.description: The stable account id this review is attributed to. Set by the backend from the verified bearer token; ignored if present on a submission. Populated when a review is read back.

reviewer.description: The reviewer account's display name, denormalized for presentation. Set by the backend; populated when a review is read back.

reviewedAt.description: When the review was submitted. Set by the backend; populated when a review is read back.

ratings.description: The reviewer's quality rating for each of the test case's declared scoring domains (see the version manifest's domains). One entry per declared domain; a review must rate every declared domain. Within this single review the overall rating is the worst across these; the run's overall rating is the worst across every review.

writeup.description: The markdown writeup body, with any rating and checklist frontmatter stripped. Must be non-empty.

checklist.description: The reviewer's verdicts on the test case's declared reviewer checklist items (see the version manifest's reviewItems). One entry per declared item; a review must give every declared item a verdict. Empty for a case that declares no items.

DomainRating.description: A reviewer's quality rating for one of the case's scoring domains.

domain.description: The declared scoring domain's stable id.

rating.description: The reviewer's verdict for this domain.

ReviewVerdict.description: A reviewer's recorded verdict on one declared checklist item.

id.description: The declared checklist item's stable id.

status.description: The verdict: pass (satisfied, earns the item's weight) or fail (not satisfied, earns none).

note.description: An optional one-line note recording what the reviewer observed.
